audit.protocol: Post-run audit; no further training or selection on final evaluation

timing.note: Updates stopped at the timer, then terminal validation ran. The recorded elapsed time includes this additional selection pass; final evaluation and benchmark sampling ran afterward.

consumer_finance.finding: ID-based holdout allowed identical narratives with different complaint IDs across partitions: 8 validation rows and 10 of 256 final rows matched inputs seen at the selected checkpoint. Complaint results and checkpoint selection are affected. Future configs now partition by narrative text; saved scores and selection remain unchanged.

audit.finding: Probabilities remain nearly uniform across all final datasets. Accuracy alone does not demonstrate useful learning. FlakeFlagger final sample contains no positive cases, so its 100% accuracy is not evidence of flaky-test detection. Exact probability-collapse mechanism is unverified. On two training-pool AG News examples, encoder option-marker cosine similarity was 0.9300 and became 1.0000 after the trainable transformer; CPU/MPS probabilities agreed within 7.45e-8. This locates representation collapse in the head on this small diagnostic, without establishing its full cause.
next_experiments: Verify a small training-only batch can be overfit; compare CPU/MPS probabilities and train/eval logits.
Measure no_transformer and linear_scorer on identical training and validation rows to isolate the head.
Use per-class recall, macro-F1 and class histograms, particularly for project-held-out FlakeFlagger.
Use content-grouped complaint holdouts and new caches; keep final scores out of selection.
Scale training only after training-only overfit and validation checks pass.

head_diagnostic.sample: two training-pool AG News rows, best checkpoint; inference only

benchmark.note: First N source-split rows, not the frozen edition's selected rows. Accuracy is over supported requests; unsupported requests are counted separately. Entropy confidence is distinct from the chosen-option probability used for calibration.
